title: fix(plugin-auth)!: refuse switching admin_full_access off when no platform administrator would remain
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DXuamRUC67fx2TTYrFfyuSH)_

Fixes #33082 — seat ruling A (Fable-reviewed). Option B (every standing half) is split out as #33423.

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — a write to `sys_metadata_activation` that switches the `admin_full_access` permission set off (`POST /security/_activation/permission/admin_full_access` with `{"enabled":false}`, or the same ledger row inserted or updated off) is now refused 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` when it would leave no unbanned platform administrator, even though an organization owner or admin is still standing. Before, the guard counted that owner and let the write land.
Metadata-protocol: none

**BREAKING** for a deployment whose platform administrators all hold their standing through the Default Organization's `admin_full_access` grants (the stock `single` deployment with no `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL`): switching that permission set off is now refused. Switching it off ends every grant-anchored platform administrator at once, and the only door that switches it back on asks for `manage_metadata`, which an organization owner or admin does not hold, so a landed switch-off left the deployment with no in-product way back. What to do: if the set really must be switched off, first declare a platform owner in `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` (a verified address); that owner keeps `manage_metadata` and can switch the set back on. Under a walled posture nothing changes.

## Maintainer quick read

- What changes: the platform's last administrator can no longer switch the `admin_full_access` permission set off by accident. Before, the switch-off was accepted and nobody could turn it back on (database surgery or a re-seed was the only fix).
- Why: the last-admin guard counted the organization owner as a remaining administrator. An owner can sign in, but cannot switch the set back on, because that needs `manage_metadata`.
- Risk and rollback: declared narrowing. On a stock `single` deployment the switch-off is now always refused, because it ends every grant-anchored platform admin at once; it lands when a configured platform owner (`OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL`) stands. Every other guard verdict is unchanged. Rollback is a revert.
- Read first: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/last-admin-guard.ts`, `refuseIfPlatformStandingEnds` and its one call in `enforceStanding`.
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/last-admin-guard.activation-ledger.test.ts`.
- Needed from you: nothing.

## What changes

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/last-admin-guard.ts`:
  - New `refuseIfPlatformStandingEnds(op, pending)`, called from `enforceStanding` only when the table is `sys_metadata_activation`, and only where the existing administrators verdict would let the write through (so a write that empties every administrator keeps that verdict's own refusal and text). It enumerates the `platform-admins` population (the existing `standing: 'platform-admins'` half set: the Default Organization's in-window `admin_full_access` grants and the verified `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` users) before and after the pending write. It re-reads bans the same way as the main verdict, and refuses when an unbanned platform admin exists before and none after. The refusal names the losing ids, says "platform administrator", explains that an organization owner cannot switch the set back on, and gives the `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` remedy.
  - The restore exemption (`before.size === 0` in `enforceStanding`) is untouched, so it reads the population it reads today.
  - The ledger-half docblock now states the second verdict.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch, the `(narrowing)` arm, the BREAKING paragraph and `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` (`check-adr-0087-registration` reads it as `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing]`).

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/last-admin-guard.activation-ledger.test.ts`:
  - The old "a second administrator left standing permits the switch-off" case used an organization owner as that second administrator, which is exactly #33082. It is replaced by:
    - the #33082 repro (the admin is also the Default Organization owner), refused for both `false` and the driver `0` spelling;
    - another user who only owns an organization: refused, and the message names the last platform administrator and `manage_metadata`;
    - the same refusal on an UPDATE of an existing row;
    - a second `admin_full_access` holder: refused, because both lose it;
    - a second holder plus an organization owner: refused by the platform verdict, naming both holders;
    - a configured, verified platform owner: the switch-off lands, and switching it back on lands;
    - CONTROL: that configured owner banned: refused.
  - The fixture's `sys_user` gains `email_verified` for the config-anchor cases.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/last-admin-guard.test.ts` (review#3 M1, N1): "an org admin elsewhere keeps the switch-off legal" encoded #33082; it now expects the 403 with "last platform administrator" and no ledger row. The path-4 header says an organization owner no longer permits it.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/catalog-activation-door.dogfood.test.ts` (review#3 M2): the CONTROL "owner still standing lands 200" is now "owner still standing is refused 403 too, and no row lands"; the header bullet and the pair's comment say why.
- New `packages/qa/dogfood/test/admin-set-switch-off-last-platform-admin.dogfood.test.ts` (stock `single` showcase, over HTTP through `POST /api/v1/security/_activation/permission/admin_full_access`):
  - no configured owner: 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`; the admin keeps `admin_full_access` and `manage_metadata`; no off row is written;
  - a configured, verified owner: the switch-off lands; the owner keeps `manage_metadata` and switches the set back on through the same door, end to end; the seeded admin's set is in effect again.
- `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx`: the switch-off paragraph states the platform-admin verdict.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run`: 272 files / 5262 tests passed (the seven `last-admin-guard.*` files: 188).
- The full dogfood battery the `(narrowing)` arm owes (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`) is running on the final head and is reported in a comment.
